posts.headline: Twenty-two editions and Thicks is STILL unbeaten at 4-0, but a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish means this ring is looking more like a participation trophy than a dynasty.
posts.detail: Tyrique14's reigning champs haven't lost, sure, but 530.16 points through four weeks isn't exactly Cowboys-level dominance — I need to see this title defense survive an actual test.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 0-4 collapse is now a full-blown historical event given a 20-8 career record and a league-best 1.5 average finish.
posts.detail: adambarner111 built a résumé that screams contender, and instead Put it in Ra sits winless at 453.58 points — this is the biggest pedigree-to-performance gap in Busters Anonymous history.gonna leave a mark.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers remain the only unbeaten team at 4-0 with a league-best 622.86 points, and triciagloston still isn't getting the respect this run deserves.
posts.detail: A 'middle' pedigree tag with a 6-7-1 career mark means nobody saw this coming, but the numbers don't lie — this is the best team in the league right now, full stop.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is winless at 0-4 and The Ultimate Light Skin's 457.44 points scored for nothing is starting to look like a biblical plague with no end date.
posts.detail: Eli's middle-tier pedigree (13-14-1 career) says this shouldn't be happening, but zero wins through four weeks says the belt was chosen for him this year, not by him.

posts.headline: BootyMunchers Inc. stay stuck at 2-2 with a 433.82 point total that confirms parkcity0613 is defecting from relevance in real time.
posts.detail: A bottom-feeder pedigree with a 9 average finish and 6-8 career mark was the warning label, and this season's scoring pace is reading the fine print exactly as advertised.
